title: Aggravation of damage — a lens on the variation tag of a panel; one supplied datum is substituted
titleEs: Agravación de daño — Inspección y cambio de un dato
description: A fictional panel (Object A) after the supplied change: the mark at the later level, a ● flag at the initial level and a ◆ flag at the later level, stripes and a bracket for the variation as supplied, and a value tag on a string above the bracket, beside the record. A real enlarged copy of the tag, the flag heads and the top of the panel grows from its source; the supplied value is struck and replaced by the alternative value, and only then does the dependent geometry (the ◆ flag, the bracket, the stripes and the mark’s edge) follow. The lens returns to its source; a Δ marker and a before/after trace keep the old value traceable. Placeholder levels on an illustrative scale; nothing is attributed, measured, valued or decided.
